description: This file is the code-behind for the MCQSet.aspx page of an online examination system. It contains event handlers and methods related to setting up exams and questions, handling dropdown selections for courses and semesters, adding questions to a database, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the SetExam ASP.NET page, handling exam setup and question management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently no active code.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for question, options, answer, question number, and tag.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database, assigns a question number, and shows a success alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam record in the database for the selected course.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Dynamically populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.
